prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify a responsive sidebar for an iPad reading app. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS/macOS. Sidebar mixes library destinations, current book chapters and Delete Account at the same hierarchy, takes most of a narrow window and loses the current book when collapsed. A book can have many long chapter titles.
